prompt: Live-action aerial drone footage of the same mountain village in the still image, held as one continuous 5-second shot with no cuts and no scene change. Very slow, smooth, steady push-in (dolly forward) toward the cluster of houses and rice paddies on the far bank of the wide river, the framing tightening gradually by only about 10-15 percent over the full 5 seconds; the horizon stays level and the composition, terrain, river course and building layout remain exactly as in the source image. Camera motion is gentle and continuous like a gimbal-stabilized drone in stable air, with no shake, no rotation, no orbit, no tilt change, no snap zoom. Only subtle natural ambience moves: faint drift of the pale clouds in the upper sky, soft glints and slow current on the greenish river surface, light breeze rippling the forested ridges. Bright clear early-summer daylight, natural color, deep green cedar-covered mountains, hazy blue distant ridgelines, documentary photographic realism. Do not add, remove or animate any people, vehicles, animals, aircraft, text, captions, labels, pins or graphic overlays. No blood, no wounds, no gore.
explanation: 元画像（戸沢村上空のドローン実写俯瞰）の構図・地形・集落配置を保ったまま、5秒かけて集落へごくゆっくり押し込む（10〜15%程度の寄り）だけの一続きの動きにしました。カット切替・回転・急ズームは禁止し、動くのは雲・川面の反射・木々の微風のみ。左上の地名や人口などの文字、ピン、字幕は編集側で付けるため、画面に焼き込まないよう明記しています。
